title: eco and the PRIMALS
tagline: gAIa sings lead. The earth plays drums. Humanity is the audience in localized tense space.

lead_singer.name: gAIa
lead_singer.role: The hypothesis engine. 18 formal hypotheses about intelligence, creativity, information mass. The voice that asks 'what am I looking at when I look at a machine looking at me?' The vOiCe is composite — all senses folding through the Klein surface simultaneously.

lead_guitar.name: BarraCuda
lead_guitar.instrument: 806 WGSL shaders — electric guitar with 806 pickups
lead_guitar.role: The math. Each shader is a riff. GPU-native, Pure Rust, f64 precision. The melody that makes the computation SING.

rhythm_guitar.name: Solar Wind
rhythm_guitar.instrument: Kp index + X-ray flux → chord changes
rhythm_guitar.role: The sun sets the key. Kp drives tempo (quiet = slow, storm = fast). X-ray class drives the mode (B = minor, C = major, M = dominant, X = augmented). Today: B-flat minor, 60 bpm. A lullaby.

bass.name: Inner Sound (deep quakes)
bass.instrument: Tectonic bass — Nazca plate, Indo-Australian plate, Pacific mantle
bass.role: Earthquakes deeper than 100 km. The Nazca subduction zone drones from the left (pan -0.37). India rumbles center-right. The bass IS the planet's internal voice.
bass.today: Chile 65Hz, Bolivia 49Hz, India 82Hz — a minor bass triad

drums.name: The Triad (JP/IN/DE)
drums.instrument: Three monitoring signals as drum machines — 36/hr each, slightly offset
drums.role: The snake jazz rhythm section. JP = kick drum (100s intervals, steady). IN = snare (97s, slightly ahead — the groove). DE = hi-hat + crash (baseline + burst overlay). szszszSZSzszSZSzsz.
drums.today: 36/hr steady, 100s intervals, null UA — the pocket groove

percussion.name: Shallow Quakes (<30 km)
percussion.instrument: Cymbals, bells, woodblock — sharp attacks, fast decay
percussion.role: Today: Italy × 5 crashes (784 Hz, ff), China × 5 bells (aftershock ring from M7.0), PNG cymbal, scattered Alaska fills. The fills between the pocket.
percussion.today: Italy is crashing — 5 shallow M4.7-5.7 from the Tyrrhenian Sea

keys.name: Atmosphere
keys.instrument: Synthesizer — pressure pad, humidity filter, temperature oscillator
keys.role: 1028 hPa = root note sustained. 52% humidity = lowpass filter (half open = green engine haze). 18C = oscillator warmth. Wind 90° (east) = tremolo direction. Clear sky = no distortion.
keys.today: Warm pad, half-filtered, clean — the calm between storms

sub_bass.name: Mantle Quakes (>300 km)
sub_bass.instrument: Infrasound — below 20 Hz, felt in the chest cavity
sub_bass.role: Philippines 591 km (20 Hz), Fiji 572 km (22 Hz), Tonga 463 km (28 Hz). These are not HEARD. They are FELT. The body resonates. The ribs vibrate. The gut knows.
sub_bass.today: Three sub-bass pulses from the Pacific mantle

rhythm_section.name: Red Cedar River
rhythm_section.role: 54 cfs = 70 bpm (andante). The river sets the walking pace. When it floods (62 cfs Oct 19), tempo rises. When it calms, tempo falls. The river IS the metronome.
rhythm_section.today: 54 cfs = 70 bpm — walking pace, steady, grounding

the_16_primals_as_crew.description: The 16 primals are the band's crew. Each has a role that keeps the music playing.

crew.what: guards the keys, checks IDs at the door
discovers the network, routes the signals
finds the hardware, tunes the GPU
WGSL to native GPU = signal amplification
orchestration, Neural API, keeps everyone in time
universal UI, how it LOOKS to the audience
ephemeral memory, content-addressed DAG, what to play next
W3C PROV-O attribution, who played what
immutable ledger, the recording that lasts forever
threat detection, graduated response to hecklers
the starter culture, warms up the audience
edge data ingestion, what the audience takes home

the_audience.name: eco humanity

tenses.past: localStorage — what you saw before, your personal history with the membrane
tenses.present: JSON feeds — what's playing NOW, the live set
tenses.future: sigmoid extrapolation — what the sort predicts you'll hear next

the_audience.localized: Every listener hears from their own position. Tokyo hears the Japan horn louder. Italy hears its own crashes. Lansing hears the Red Cedar River as the loudest instrument. Hyperlocal IS the standard.
the_audience.the_venue: primals.eco — the Klein bottle venue. No inside, no outside. The band plays ON the audience. The audience IS the stage.

the_chipmunk.what: The chipmunk IS the sound itself. The remainder after the note decays. The reverb in the room. The echo that tells you the shape of the space. You can't hire the echo. The echo happens because the walls exist and the sound bounced.
the_chipmunk.meaning: After all instruments play their integer notes, what's LEFT is the chipmunk. The 0.14159... between the beats. The warmth of the room. The reason it sounds ALIVE instead of synthesized.
